nehemiah.10.p1.b1.text: Now these were the ones who sealed the document: Nehemiah the governor, son of Hacaliah, and also Zedekiah,

nehemiah.10.p1.b3.text: The Levites: Jeshua son of Azaniah, Binnui of the sons of Henadad, Kadmiel,

nehemiah.10.p1.b4.text: And the leaders of the people: Parosh, Pahath-moab, Elam, Zattu, Bani,

nehemiah.10.p2.b1.text: The rest of the people—the priests, Levites, gatekeepers, singers, temple servants … along with their wives and all their sons and daughters who are able to understand,

nehemiah.10.p2.b2.text: … commit themselves with a sworn oath to follow the Law of God given through His servant Moses and to carefully obey all the commandments, ordinances, and statutes of the LORD our Lord.

nehemiah.10.p3.b1.text: We will not give our daughters in marriage to the people of the land, and we will not take their daughters for our sons.

nehemiah.10.p3.b2.text: Every seventh year we will let the fields lie fallow, and will cancel every debt.

nehemiah.10.p3.b3.text: When the people of the land bring merchandise or any kind of grain to sell on the Sabbath day, we will not buy from them on a Sabbath or holy day.

nehemiah.10.p3.b4.text: We also place ourselves under the obligation to contribute a third of a shekel yearly for the service of the house of our God:

nehemiah.10.p4.b1.text: We have cast lots among the priests, Levites, and people for the donation of wood by our families at the appointed times each year. They are to bring it to the house of our God …

nehemiah.10.p4.b2.text: We will also bring the firstfruits of our land and of every fruit tree to the house of the LORD year by year.

nehemiah.10.p4.b3.text: A priest of Aaron’s line is to accompany the Levites when they collect the tenth …

nehemiah.10.p4.b4.text: … to the storerooms where the articles of the sanctuary are kept and where the ministering priests, the gatekeepers, and the singers stay. Thus we will not neglect the house of our God.
